d: Ready to shape Islamic finance growth across the MENAT region?

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

As a Regional Head of Islamic Finance, you’ll help develop and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region, based in the UAE. Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. You’ll bring market awareness and practical judgement to help keep our propositions relevant and well governed.
q: Bring substantial experience in Islamic finance gained within a bank, financial institution or relevant market participant
Demonstrate deep GCC experience with proven exposure to the UAE market
Show a track record of originating, structuring and executing Shariah-compliant financing transactions
Evidence collaboration with relationship managers and coverage teams to progress opportunities from origination to execution
Apply proven capability across bilateral financing, syndicated financing and structured finance
Demonstrate experience drafting Islamic term sheets and reviewing transaction documentation with external legal counsel
Apply strong working knowledge of AAOIFI Shariah standards and relevant UAE regulatory and Shariah governance requirements
Show experience supporting or delivering new Islamic product launches including operational implementation with internal stakeholders

If you want to work at the centre of Islamic finance origination, structuring and product expansion across MENAT, this role offers a rare mix of advisory depth and execution responsibility. You’ll help clients access Shariah-compliant solutions across corporate and investment banking needs while keeping standards of governance and control front and centre. The scope spans complex transactions, new product delivery and close partnership with coverage teams and control functions. If this matches the work you’ve done and the impact you want to have, we’d like to hear from you.
r: li
Shape and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region
li
Partner with relationship managers and business heads to identify and convert Islamic financing opportunities across GCC and wider MENAT
li
Structure and execute Islamic finance transactions across bilateral and syndicated financing, structured finance and asset-backed transactions
li
Draft and review Islamic term sheets, indicative proposals, transaction structures and approval papers
li
Coordinate Shariah adviser engagement and governance forum approvals to resolve Shariah-related matters
li
Oversee transaction progression through credit approval, Shariah approval, documentation, conditions precedent, closing and post-closing requirements
li
Develop and launch new Islamic finance products across the CIB platform including due diligence, manuals, processes and client materials
li
Strengthen risk, controls and conduct outcomes by identifying execution risks early and ensuring appropriate reviews and auditability
